items.title: Benjie White Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Funny thing, there was a band here, not a band, but a string outfit called the Six and Seven Eights, if you recall, which Dr. Sushong was just on This Is Your Life, as you recall.

ctx.x: I was born originally on First Street. And we moved from there to Valmont. We moved many times, various locations. Of course, Pine Street was the... I was actually, as a boy, I can recall my life on Calhoun, 1467 Calhoun Street, which was quite a neighborhood for young boys. We had, I guess, about 25 youngsters, all about the same age, within a radius of two city blocks there. We went to LaSalle Grammar School. I'd rather LaSalle... Yeah, the Grammar School.
